name: time-center
description: Mac tray app that tracks where your time goes, joins meetings on time, and turns them into TODOs.
author: Ryan Shillington

scripts.package: npm run native && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir && node scripts/signing.mts sign "dist/mac-arm64/Time Center.app"
scripts.dist: npm run package && electron-builder --mac dmg --prepackaged "dist/mac-arm64/Time Center.app"
scripts.spike:audio:electron: rolldown spike/system-audio/electronLoopback.ts --file out/spike/electronLoopback.cjs --format cjs --platform node --external electron && electron out/spike/electronLoopback.cjs
